subject: Integration accelerant: proposed schedule, traffic-slicing and safety nets
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <srao@novatrust.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Kapoor <m.kapoor@novatrust.com>, Procurement <procurement@novatrust.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up & request for rapid onboarding lanes

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the RFP response — we appreciate Redwood's clarity. Our leadership wants an accelerated onboarding path for a subset of integrations (payments adapters + account lookup). We have a hard target to start limited live traffic by mid-November.

Can you provide: a compressed timeline (11-week target), the minimum integration touchpoints per adapter, and explicit canary success criteria (SLOs, telemetry hooks, rollback gates)? Also attach any migration-runbook you usually share for accelerated customers.

We attached our internal adapter inventory and an initial risk register. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support parallel onboarding lanes (multiple adapters being onboarded concurrently) and whether we can get a dedicated mobilization window for Dedicated capacity?

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Integrations
NovaTrust Financial

Attachments: novatrust-adapter-inventory.csv (64KB), nt-risk-register.xlsx (120KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <srao@novatrust.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up & request for rapid onboarding lanes

Hi Sanjay — thanks, and yes we can support parallel onboarding lanes. I sketched a compact "integration accelerant" proposal and attached a condensed timeline + a canary/runbook draft. High level:

- 11-week compressed schedule (Mobilization + Integration + Canary + Ramp)
  - Weeks 0–1: Mobilization — account provisioning, SSO/KMS onboarding, network allowlists, Dedicated capacity reservation window confirmed.
  - Weeks 2–5: Integration lanes (parallel): implement adapter-side transforms, schema mapping, and handshake tests. We recommend 3 concurrent lanes max for predictability.
  - Week 6: End-to-end test day + smoke with staging traffic slices (1–5% of sessions).
  - Week 7: Canary 1 (limited live traffic, low-latency tenants) — 5–10% traffic; evaluate telemetry.
  - Weeks 8–9: Instrumented ramp to 30% with progressive latency/quality checks.
  - Week 10: Full cutover plan validation and DR/backout rehearsal.
  - Week 11: Go-live acceptance window.

- Canary success criteria (examples):
  - 95th percentile latency < 180ms on 512-token median requests for critical paths
  - Token cost within 1.2x of baseline on sample workload
  - Error rate (5xx + model-delta) < 0.5%
  - No regression on 3 tracked prompt sets (automated evals pass)

- Rollback gates: sustained latency > 200ms for 15m, or quality regression on core eval set, or >1% unexplained 5xx for 5m.

- Safety nets: automatic fallback to a smaller model variant + traffic reroute to hosted region; prefix caching for heavy queries; pre-wired support escalation path to our on-call infra team.

I'm attaching:
- redwood-integration-accelerant-timeline.xlsx (condensed milestones)
- accelerant-canary-runbook-v1.pdf (playbook + telemetry hooks)
- adapter-mapping-vendor-inventory.csv (template for mapping)

Next steps: confirm which 3 adapters you want in lane A/B/C, agree mobilization week, and we'll lock Dedicated capacity.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions PM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-integration-accelerant-timeline.xlsx, accelerant-canary-runbook-v1.pdf, adapter-mapping-vendor-inventory.csv

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Rao <srao@novatrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@novatrust.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration accelerant: proposed schedule, traffic-slicing and safety nets

Thanks Grace — a few operational points from infra and reliability:

- Observability hooks: we will publish a telemetry dashboard per adapter (latency P50/P95, token-rate, model-delta alarms). We embed an evaluation job that runs every 60 minutes against the three gold prompt sets you selected.
- Traffic-slicing policy: Recommend header-based routing so we can send a deterministic 1% slice for staging; we will provide the routing key and sample client snippet.
- Autoscaling and Dedicated pool: to guarantee the windows, we need a confirmed commit for Dedicated ramp (temporary burst pool is possible but costs more). Can your procurement team confirm a mobilization deposit?
- Backout rehearsals: We'll require one dry-run with the on-call responder performing the rollback procedure. That’s included in Week 10.

Also flagging potential integration blockers: certain adapters that do high-throughput synchronous calls may need our batched-response adapter pattern instead of single-request flows. If you send the adapter inventory mapping into our template we can call out which lanes need pattern changes.

-Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Rao <srao@novatrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration accelerant: proposed schedule, traffic-slicing and safety nets

Adding model/efficiency constraints and a few recommendations from the Serving team:

- Quantization profile: for the high-throughput adapter lane we recommend int8 quantization + kernel selection for your preferred sequence lengths. That tends to reduce cost by ~2.3x with modest quality delta — we should include a small A/B on quality during Canary 1.
- Batching strategy: configure continuous batching with an upper bound latency budget of 120ms for non-interactive flows. For interactive customer journeys use smaller batch windows.
- Cache priming: preload common prompts to the KV cache during Canary to keep cold-start noise low.

Success metrics to track in parallel (ops + model):
- Cost per 1k tokens (baseline vs canary)
- Regresion score on eval suite (binary pass/fail per run)
- Mean time to rollback (<10 minutes target)

I'll prepare a one-page ops checklist for each lane and flag the model variants we will use for the initial canary.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <srao@novatrust.com>, Maya Kapoor <m.kapoor@novatrust.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 17:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration accelerant: proposed schedule, traffic-slicing and safety nets

Sanjay / Maya — great to align. Per your inventory, please prioritize these three adapters for initial lanes: payments-bridge, account-lookup, and payouts. If that works we will:

1) Lock mobilization week: Oct 5 (Week 0) — we'll provision Dedicated capacity Oct 5–9 and share SSO/KMS onboarding checklist.
2) Send lane assignments and the completed adapter mapping template by EOD Monday (Sep 27).
3) Procurement: please confirm mobilization deposit and counterparty SOW review by Sep 30 so we can reserve the GPU pool.
4) We'll run Canary 1 on Nov 9 and schedule the rollback dry-run on Nov 16.

Deliverables we will provide this week:
- Finalized accelerant timeline (spreadsheet)
- One-page ops checklist per lane (PDF)
- Canary runbook with telemetry links and play-by-play

If procurement wants alternative billing terms (monthly vs quarter) flag it now — we can propose a short-term burst commitment to reduce upfront. Otherwise we'll issue a standard mobilization invoice.

I'll attach the one-page checklists and the runbook to this thread for your legal/procurement review.

Thanks — looking forward to starting.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0128
